summary.text: Rick Ryan is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 36, where he has served since January 2025, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he succeeded Kelly M. Burke in the seat.

paragraphs.text: Rick Ryan was born in Oak Lawn, Illinois, and graduated from Brother Rice High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from DePaul University in 1989 and a law degree from John Marshall Law School in 1992, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
Ryan assumed office on January 8, 2025, after Kelly M. Burke, and advanced from the March 17, 2026 Democratic primary.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Appropriations-General Service, Health Care Licenses, Judiciary - Criminal, International Relations, Tourism, and Trade, and State Government Administration committees.
Ballotpedia lists David Sheppard (R) as the other candidate on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for the seat.
